state.$description: Opacities of interaction states that components apply themselves. envUI's own hover and pressed colors are color tokens of their own (color.bg, color.fg, color.border); a component given colors through its color properties draws its states as state layers instead: its content color at these opacities over its container, as Material draws them.

disabled-opacity.$description: The opacity of a disabled control, which keeps its colors: 48%.

hover-opacity.$description: The state layer under the pointer: 8% of the content color over the container.

focus-opacity.$description: The state layer of keyboard focus, under the focus ring: 10% of the content color.

pressed-opacity.$description: The state layer while pressed: 10% of the content color over the container.
